notes.title: First patch for the game was released
notes.content:
We have released the first patch for our game. Here is the list of the fixes that were made for the game:
+ Added mouse inversion
+ Fixed some grammar errors
+ Motion blur has been disabled
+ Fixed some bugs with collisions
+ Improved sword damage system
+ Bugs related to Steam were fixed
+ Partially improved graphics in the last level
+ Some bugs related to sounds were fixed
